views.name: vw_active_policies
views.sql: SELECT policy_id, policy_status, premium_amount FROM insurance.policy.policies WHERE policy_status = 'ACTIVE'

views.name: vw_policy_summary
views.sql: SELECT p.policy_id, p.policy_status, COUNT(c.claim_id) AS claim_count FROM insurance.policy.policies p LEFT JOIN insurance.policy.claims c ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id GROUP BY p.policy_id, p.policy_status

views.name: vw_claims_by_policy
views.sql: SELECT c.claim_id, c.policy_id, c.claim_amount FROM insurance.policy.claims c

queries.sql: SELECT policy_status, COUNT(*) AS policy_count FROM insurance.policy.policies GROUP BY policy_status
SELECT date_trunc('month', effective_date) AS month, SUM(premium_amount) AS total_premium FROM insurance.policy.policies GROUP BY 1
